description: Finds the zodiac sign (Sun sign, star sign) of a birth date and returns its reading: personality, strengths, what holds one back, what helps. On a day when the Sun changes sign, give the birth time and time zone to settle it; otherwise both possible signs are returned.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

name: sun_sign
title: Zodiac sign (Sun sign)
